title: Todo App - SLOs, Traffic & Infrastructure
description: SLI/SLO (uptime, availability, latency), RED metrics, business KPIs, container & node CPU/memory. SLOs: availability 99.5 %, latency 95 % < 250 ms.

panels.title: Service level objectives  -  uptime, availability, latency  (range = dashboard time picker)
Uptime (probe)
panels.description: Share of 15 s black-box probes of backend /health/ready that returned 2xx. SLO: 99.5 %.

panels.title: Availability SLI
panels.description: Requests answered without a 5xx / all requests. SLO: 99.5 %.

panels.title: Error budget remaining
panels.description: 100 % = no 5xx; 0 % = the 0.5 % error budget of the 99.5 % availability SLO is spent.

panels.title: Latency SLI (< 250 ms)
panels.description: Requests served in under 250 ms. SLO: 95 %.

panels.title: Burn rate (1 h)
panels.description: Error-budget burn rate over the last hour. 1 = exactly on budget; > 6 pages (fast-burn).

panels.title: Total requests (range)
panels.description: All HTTP requests handled by the backend in the selected range (health probes excluded).

panels.title: Successful requests (2xx/3xx)
panels.description: Total over the selected time range.

panels.title: Requests per second by status class
Error ratio (%)
panels.description: Red line = 5 % alert threshold on 5xx ratio.

panels.title: Failed requests by route (4xx/5xx per second)
Login success rate
panels.description: Successful / all login attempts in range. Persistent dips indicate credential-stuffing or a broken login.

panels.title: Containers  -  CPU / memory  (red line = 40 % alert threshold)
Container CPU utilisation (% of CPU limit)

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"todo-.+"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (name) (max by (name) (container_spec_cpu_quota{name=~"todo-.+"}) / max by (name) (container_spec_cpu_period{name=~"todo-.+"}) > 0)

panels.title: Container memory utilisation (% of memory limit)
Recent errors  (Elasticsearch - full search in Kibana)

targets.query: log.level:(error OR ERROR OR warning OR WARNING OR critical OR CRITICAL)
